# difNLR

DIF and DDF Detection by Non-Linear Regression Models.

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/adelahladka/difNLR/workflows/R-CMD-check/badge.svg)](https://github.com/adelahladka/difNLR/actions)
[![Codecov test
coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/adelahladka/difNLR/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/adelahladka/difNLR)
[![CRAN
version](https://www.r-pkg.org/badges/version/difNLR?color=#F0E442)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=difNLR)
[![CRAN
downloads](http://cranlogs.r-pkg.org/badges/grand-total/badger?color=#0072B2)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=badger)
[![Last
commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/adelahladka/difNLR.svg)](https://github.com/adelahladka/difNLR/commits/master)

## Description

The **difNLR** package provides methods for detecting differential item
functioning (DIF) using non-linear regression models. Both uniform and
non-uniform DIF effects can be detected when considering a single focal
group. Additionally, the method allows for testing differences in
guessing or inattention parameters between the reference and focal
group. DIF detection is performed using either a likelihood-ratio test,
an F-test, or Wald’s test of a submodel. The software offers a variety
of algorithms for estimating item parameters.

Furthermore, the **difNLR** package includes methods for detecting
differential distractor functioning (DDF) using multinomial log-linear
regression model. It also introduces DIF detection approaches for
ordinal data via adjacent category logit and cumulative logit regression
models.

![difNLR](reference/figures/DIF_NLR.png)![difORD](reference/figures/DDF_CLRM_cumulative.png)![difORD](reference/figures/DDF_CLRM_category.png)

## Installation

The easiest way to get **difNLR** package is to install it from CRAN:

    install.packages("difNLR")

Or you can get the newest development version from GitHub:

    # install.packages("devtools")
    devtools::install_github("adelahladka/difNLR")

## Version

Current version on [**CRAN**](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=difNLR)
is 1.5.2-2. The newest development version available on
[**GitHub**](https://github.com/adelahladka/difNLR) is 1.5.3-1.

## Reference

To cite the **difNLR** package in publications, please, use:

- Hladka, A. & Martinkova, P. (2020). difNLR: Generalized logistic
  regression models for DIF and DDF detection. *The R Journal, 12*(1),
  300–323, <https://doi.org/10.32614/RJ-2020-014>

&nbsp;

- Drabinova, A. & Martinkova, P. (2017). Detection of differential item
  functioning with nonlinear regression: A non-IRT approach accounting
  for guessing. *Journal of Educational Measurement, 54*(4), 498–517,
  <https://doi.org/10.1111/jedm.12158>

To cite new estimation approaches provided in the
[`difNLR()`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/difNLR.md)
function, please, use:

- Hladka, A., Martinkova, P., & Brabec, M. (2026). New iterative
  algorithms for estimation of item functioning. *Journal of Educational
  and Behavioral Statistics, 51*(1), 175–205,
  <https://doi.org/10.3102/10769986241312354>

## Try online

You can try some functionalities of the **difNLR** package
[online](https://shiny.cs.cas.cz/ShinyItemAnalysis/) using the
[**ShinyItemAnalysis**](https://github.com/patriciamar/ShinyItemAnalysis)
application and package and its DIF/Fairness section.

## Getting help

In case you find any bug or just need help with the **difNLR** package,
you can leave your message as an issue here or directly contact us at
<hladka@cs.cas.cz>

# Package index

## Package overview

- [`difNLR-package`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/difNLR-package.md)
  : DIF and DDF Detection by Non-Linear Regression Models.

## Core functions

- [`difNLR()`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/difNLR.md)
  : DIF detection using non-linear regression method.
- [`difORD()`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/difORD.md)
  : DIF detection among ordinal data.
- [`ddfMLR()`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/ddfMLR.md)
  : DDF detection for nominal data.
- [`genNLR()`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/genNLR.md)
  : Generates data set based on generalized logistic regression DIF and
  DDF models.

## Helper functions

- [`startNLR()`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/startNLR.md)
  : Calculates starting values for non-linear regression DIF models.
- [`estimNLR()`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/estimNLR.md)
  [`logLik(`*`<estimNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/estimNLR.md)
  [`coef(`*`<estimNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/estimNLR.md)
  [`fitted(`*`<estimNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/estimNLR.md)
  [`residuals(`*`<estimNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/estimNLR.md)
  [`print(`*`<estimNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/estimNLR.md)
  [`vcov(`*`<estimNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/estimNLR.md)
  : Non-linear regression DIF models estimation.
- [`formulaNLR()`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/formulaNLR.md)
  : Creates a formula for non-linear regression DIF models.
- [`MLR()`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/MLR.md) : DDF
  likelihood ratio statistics based on multinomial log-linear regression
  model.
- [`NLR()`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/NLR.md) : DIF
  statistics for non-linear regression models.
- [`ORD()`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/ORD.md) : DIF
  likelihood ratio statistics for ordinal data.

## Utilities

- [`coef(`*`<difNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/coef.difNLR.md)
  :

  Extract item parameter estimates from an object of the `"difNLR"`
  class.

- [`logLik(`*`<difNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/logLik.difNLR.md)
  [`AIC(`*`<difNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/logLik.difNLR.md)
  [`BIC(`*`<difNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/logLik.difNLR.md)
  :

  Log-likelihood and information criteria for an object of the
  `"difNLR"` class.

- [`plot(`*`<difNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/plot.difNLR.md)
  :

  ICC and test statistics plots for an object of the `"difNLR"` class.

- [`predict(`*`<difNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/predict.difNLR.md)
  :

  Predicted values for an object of the `"difNLR"` class.

- [`fitted(`*`<difNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/residuals.difNLR.md)
  [`residuals(`*`<difNLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/residuals.difNLR.md)
  :

  Fitted values and residuals for an object of the `"difNLR"` class.

- [`coef(`*`<difORD>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/coef.difORD.md)
  :

  Extract model coefficients from an object of `"difORD"` class.

- [`logLik(`*`<difORD>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/logLik.difORD.md)
  [`AIC(`*`<difORD>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/logLik.difORD.md)
  [`BIC(`*`<difORD>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/logLik.difORD.md)
  :

  Log-likelihood and information criteria for an object of `"difORD"`
  class.

- [`plot(`*`<difORD>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/plot.difORD.md)
  :

  ICC plots for an object of `"difORD"` class.

- [`predict(`*`<difORD>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/predict.difORD.md)
  :

  Predicted values for an object of `"difORD"` class.

- [`coef(`*`<ddfMLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/coef.ddfMLR.md)
  :

  Extract model coefficients from an object of `"ddfMLR"` class.

- [`logLik(`*`<ddfMLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/logLik.ddfMLR.md)
  [`AIC(`*`<ddfMLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/logLik.ddfMLR.md)
  [`BIC(`*`<ddfMLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/logLik.ddfMLR.md)
  :

  Log-likelihood and information criteria for an object of `"ddfMLR"`
  class.

- [`plot(`*`<ddfMLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/plot.ddfMLR.md)
  :

  ICC plots for an object of `"ddfMLR"` class.

- [`predict(`*`<ddfMLR>`*`)`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/predict.ddfMLR.md)
  :

  Predicted values for an object of `"ddfMLR"` class.

## Data

- [`GMAT`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/GMAT.md) :
  Dichotomous dataset based on GMAT with the same total score
  distribution for groups.

- [`GMATkey`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/GMATkey.md)
  :

  Key of correct answers for `GMATtest` dataset.

- [`GMATtest`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/GMATtest.md)
  : Dataset based on GMAT with the same total score distribution for
  groups.

- [`GMAT2`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/GMAT2.md) :
  Dichotomous dataset based on GMAT.

- [`GMAT2key`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/GMAT2key.md)
  :

  Key of correct answers for `GMAT2test` dataset.

- [`GMAT2test`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/GMAT2test.md)
  : Dataset based on GMAT.

- [`MSATB`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/MSATB.md) :
  Dichotomous dataset of Medical School Admission Test in Biology.

- [`MSATBkey`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/MSATBkey.md)
  :

  Key of correct answers for `MSATBtest` dataset.

- [`MSATBtest`](https://adelahladka.github.io/difNLR/reference/MSATBtest.md)
  : Dataset of School Admission Test in Biology.
